notes: Adds a bilingual macOS Accessibility helper with a draggable current-app card and clear stale-entry recovery guidance.
After real Accessibility authorization succeeds, reveals Clipboard first and then plays a one-shot split-and-particle completion animation.
Breaks down local storage by data type and can selectively clear clipboard, Agent activity, and Adapter revision history while protecting resources and configuration.
Removes default circular Material hover halos and shakes the macOS menu-bar icon when a new clipboard copy is detected.
